export_evidence: ImportKey page for slug 'cineom-broadcast-india-limited' shows 1056 records, but every visible row is an INBOUND (import) entry into India, e.g. "2026-02-27 | CINEOM BROADCAST INDIA LIMITED | ARNOLD RICHTER CINE TECHNIK GMBH | CINEMATOGRAPHY CAMERA PART : SENSOR ... | MUNICH, GERMANY | 85299090 | BOL 1066745" — buyer = Cineom, destination = SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India. No outbound shipment row with an Indian-origin port and a foreign destination was seen. Source counter: page header claims "Total Shipments 1056 Records detected" / "Trading Partners 21" / "Ports 25"; rows actually rendered in the free view = 5 shipment rows, all imports.
note: Only import-side customs activity is documented: 1056 India import records on ImportKey (latest cargo 2026-02-27), top ports SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC (45), MUNICH (34), FRASER PORT (18); suppliers are ARRI/Arnold & Richter Cine Technik (Germany), Ross Video (Canada), Kent Faith International (Hong Kong), BH Photo Video (USA). This confirms the company is an active importer/distributor of broadcast and cinematography equipment, not an exporter. No export bill of lading, no export destination and no export HS line was found, so export_status = none_found (traces of outbound shipments not found), not 'declared_only'. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: the web_search tool failed on every call (searx: connection refused) and volza, eximpedia and trademo free views all returned HTTP 403. Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown with null evidence — this is a tooling gap, not a negative finding. Declared HS 851989 (sound/video recording or reproducing apparatus) is broadly consistent with the observed import HS codes 85299090, 85285900, 90022000, 76169990, but the actual traded HS codes are those import codes; no HS-based rejection applies per project rule 3. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the sources reachable. Role: trader/distributor (importer of ARRI, Ross Video and other brands), not a manufacturer. No registry or catalogue data used.
